final.memo:
The situation at Yahoo! has reached a point where passive engagement is no longer sufficient. While the original thesis regarding the value of Asian assets and the latent potential of the core business remains intact [D07], [D08], we are witnessing a governance failure of the highest order. The recent identification of discrepancies between the CEO's stated academic credentials and institutional records, alongside similar issues with director Patti Hart, is unacceptable and demands an immediate, public response [D02], [D03].

Operating performance continues to lag, with first-quarter operating income falling 11%, proving that the current leadership is unable to convert the company’s assets into sustainable earnings growth [D01]. We have already nominated four director candidates, and the time for private, polite dialogue has passed [D07]. 

We must escalate our campaign to ensure that the board is reconstituted with individuals who possess the technical and media experience necessary to oversee this business with integrity [D03]. The mispricing persists, and with the annual meeting approaching, we will use our 5.8% stake to demand the board accountability that shareholders deserve [D07], [D08]. We are not waiting for internal investigations to run their course; the credibility of the board and management is the primary catalyst for unlocking the value we see.
